## Summary

The `--model gemini-2.5-flash-preview` flag was being rejected in `loadCliConfig` (`packages/cli/src/config/config.ts:678`), which calls `isValidModelOrAlias()`. That model name wasn't in `VALID_GEMINI_MODELS`, and because it starts with `gemini-` it also failed the "custom model" allowance — so validation threw a `FatalConfigError`.

Fix, in `packages/core/src/config/models.ts`:
- Added `PREVIEW_GEMINI_2_5_FLASH_MODEL = 'gemini-2.5-flash-preview'`.
- Added it to the `VALID_GEMINI_MODELS` set.

This makes the model pass validation. The existing resolution logic already handles the rest correctly:
- `specifiedModel = argv.model || process.env['GEMINI_MODEL'] || settings.model?.name` gives the `--model` flag priority over settings.
- Since `gemini-2.5-flash-preview` isn't an alias, `resolveModel` passes it through unchanged into `resolvedModel`, so `getModel()` returns exactly `'gemini-2.5-flash-preview'`.

No test files were modified.
